purpose: An in-memory meter of the requests an app received and answered, how long a page took to paint, and how long a write took.
namedChanges: the global key, target, clock and limits become options
subscribe replaces subscribePaint and also fires on setStart and writes
a throwing listener no longer stops the others
installProofHooks takes a hooks object and a key instead of one clearCache function

library.title: Speed readings (requests, page paint, writes)
library.note: An in-memory meter an app calls so it reports speed readings: requests received and answered by route, the time from a page's start to its first rows and to the full list with where the rows came from, the start of the read copy, and write timings. It only records; Speed Lab judges. For the copy itself take speed-kit; for the line that says when data was updated take updated-line.
